description: Land Acquisition -1). Katuwana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District, 2) Amended Extra gazette Number Uda Eriyagama kandy District. Amended Extra Gazette Number , Monaragala District.
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including notices of government intent to acquire specific lands, amendments to land lot numbers and sizes, and descriptions of land parcels with details about claimants, original owners, and land extents. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
